# DSH permission artwork

Source: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/5badb15009ae1756c3afe0ae0cef1faafc290ccc

Pinned SDK: dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1 / @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives 0.2.1-alpha.1.
The three official ReadOnlyArtwork, WorkspaceWriteArtwork and FullAccessArtwork glyphs
are converted to VectorDrawable with original 16 × 16 paths and regular one-pixel strokes.
Used by the official lightweight engine sandbox controls; no permission policy is changed.
